recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-40733 unless a future process requires mirroring Extension Pack retirement metadata into a core-generated registry; future edits to the extension definition itself belong in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-40733 was an Applied/Persuasive Vocab change request for FHIR-core CodeSystem asking that http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/codesystem-history be revisited because it referenced a value set and should instead be based on Provenance as used in THO; the approved resolution was to retire the extension.
initial_application: Core FHIR no longer contains an active codesystem-history StructureDefinition after the R5 extension definitions were removed from core in dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0. The active Extension Pack source was later changed by 2d8d6741385fe7229cd5fbeb5ee276ec0abe31a5, which explicitly included FHIR-40733 and changed StructureDefinition-codesystem-history.xml from active to retired.
additional_context: The current Extension Pack file marks the extension deprecated, sets status retired, and says history should be recorded using Provenance instead. Vocab Confluence minutes for 2024-04-08 record that THO uses Provenance bundles to track history and that the group decided to retire the extension. The current core checkout has no source/fhir.ini reference and only retains the historical OID assignment in source/oids.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. Editing core would not change the authoritative extension definition, and removing the OID assignment would not be the requested retirement.
